schema.description: Preset window: `7d`, `30d`, `90d`, or `365d`; availability is tier-dependent. To use a custom window, provide both `from` and `to` as timezone-aware datetimes (`to` later than `from`); custom bounds override `range` and cannot exceed the tier's maximum analytics window. Results are clamped to the tier's data-retention window.
schema.title: Range

schema.description: Group results by exactly one of `project`, `day`, `model`, or `provider`. `project` is available on every tier; the rest follow the tier's analytics entitlement. Rows for `project` carry `project_name`, `current_period_cost`, and `daily`, and include every active project even when it has no spend in the window.
schema.title: Group By
